observedCause.finding: The canonical case coverage reader accepts only case-coverage selectors; source-scenario W16 connects it as the entire resolveForecastCoverage function although Planner.simulateScenario also resolves the forecast baseRef. A raw source selector therefore returns needs-input/invalid-coverage-reference.

The existing baseline coverage registration authenticates caseScopeDigest over id, incarnation, horizon, currency and criteria. source-scenario adds the ceiling criterion after renewal fixture registration. The saved baseline scope is then invalid and cannot be repaired by merely attaching its reader.

The canonical fixture keeps coverageVersions in a private Map and uses it as expectedVersion for later resolveTraining registrations. A separate registration by the WP13 consumer would advance the durable counter without updating that owner map.
